## Local fallback reliability

- Retry the local Ollama fallback once without JSON mode when it returns an empty answer.
- Disable model "thinking" output so answers are not left empty.
- Add safe Ollama response error codes (`empty_content`, `thinking_only`, `invalid_message`) to error reports.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/MaddogSTD/engineering-app/compare/v0.1.35...v0.1.36
